personal-botA self-hosted personal assistant

It runs on your own machine, keeps its memory in files you own, and answers in the chats you already use.

Quick start
How it works

Read

Received messages come from a private, decrypted copy of the client's own database - real message ids, senders, mentions, quotes and images, without touching the client's process.

Write

Text, images, stickers, @mentions and quote replies go through the client's own send function, paced by one action queue with human-like jitter.

Remember

Notes the assistant writes itself are its only long-term memory; every turn and tool call lands in a searchable log.

Come back later

wait, wake words, scheduled tasks, and optional free turns - a turn of its own when nothing has happened for a while.

Use tools

Web search and page reading, a shell and files in a sandbox, skills and MCP servers - each function switched on or off in the panel.

Panel

Live view and login, conversations and policies, persona, memory, stickers, schedules, models, safety, workspace, advanced settings and logs - one page per topic.

Read this first

This project drives a third-party desktop client, which is outside that client's terms of service and can get an account restricted or lost. Use a secondary account, a residential connection and the default pacing. Private research project, provided as is, and all of the risk is yours. Read the disclaimer before you run anything.

What it is ​

Four containers. One runs a chat client on a virtual display; the other three are the assistant, the panel you drive it from, and a sandbox the assistant's commands run in. One stack is one account.

┌──────────────────────────── one stack = one account ──────────────────────────┐
│                                                                                  │
│  chat client (official, unmodified, headless)                                    │
│    │ writes              ▲ sends              ▲ clicks 登录                       │
│    ▼                     │                    │                                  │
│  private decrypted copy ──▶ driver API (HTTP + WebSocket)                        │
│                              │                        │                          │
│                              ▼                        ▼                          │
│                          console :8080            bot :8766                      │
│                          (the panel,              (the agent, notes,             │
│                           the live view)           the send review)              │
│                                                      │                           │
│                                                      ▼                           │
│                                                  sandbox :8791                   │
│                                                  (every command, as an           │
│                                                   unprivileged user)             │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

Models: whatever pi supports ​

The agent is built on pi, so every provider and model pi supports is available: log a provider in, or add a key, on the console's 模型 page. The model catalog is fetched at bot start and refreshed automatically once a day (neither when PI_OFFLINE=1), and can be refreshed on demand, so new models appear without a restart.

The full project write-up is the repository's README; the context and memory mechanism is docs/how-it-works.md.
